items.question: What duration and blue lotus-born offerings accomplish the same divine subjugation?
items.inference: The rite's efficacy is tied to a twenty-one-night period and blue lotus-born materials.
uncertainties: Exact referent of nīraja is unclear.
items.plain_english: Thus, in twenty-one nights, with blue and lotus-born offerings.
